info.title: pika/pika-sfx
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "pika/pika-sfx", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

duration.description: Length of the sound effect in seconds, 1 to 20.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible output, -1 to 2147483647. -1 picks a random seed.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Pika's audio models: the terminal `GET /proxy/pika/v1/media/jobs/{request_id}` job document. The produced audio is at `output.audio.url`. Pika's `billing` record is removed.

url.description: Download URL of the generated file.

id.description: Job id used to poll for status.

model_id.description: The Pika catalog entry the job ran.

status.description: Job status: queued, running, completed or failed.

usage.description: Units Pika reported for the job.

code.description: Machine-readable failure code, such as invalid_input, content_moderation or provider_error.

PikaMediaJobOutput.description: The finished job's media, set when `status` is `completed`.

media_type.description: Which field carries the file: video or audio.
